intent: The librarian's tenure loop: standing is EARNED by independent corroboration and lost by decay — a node minted from an utterance cannot count as resolution evidence for that same utterance, a duplicate deposit becomes a provenance append (charter edge b's recorded switch), and standing rises only when a different crossing independently walks to the node. watchme.trigger: every pulse reaching the librarian's shim — the probe reads the standing distribution and crossing counts from the librarian's own tree store (its component, its read). watchme.enough: cleared by ONE node standing 'earned' whose corroborations span >= 2 distinct crossings, coexisting with >= 1 uncorroborated node measurably faded from walk reach — an existence claim on both halves of the loop (promotion AND decay), one witnessed instance each settles it.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier (the default carrier), depositing the observed standing distribution and the witnessing node ids
